reconstructed_captions.26: A low-angle shot shows the C-130 just moments before its wheels touch the ground.
reconstructed_captions.27: The C-130's wheels make contact with the desert floor, beginning to kick up dust.
reconstructed_captions.28: The large military plane rolls along the desert floor after touching down.
reconstructed_captions.29: The C-130 continues its landing roll, kicking up a growing cloud of dust.
reconstructed_captions.30: The dust cloud behind the rolling C-130 expands as the plane moves past the camera.
reconstructed_captions.31: The C-130 passes by the camera, rolling quickly along the cracked desert ground.
reconstructed_captions.32: As the plane moves past, the cloud of dust it generates begins to obscure its rear.
reconstructed_captions.33: The C-130 continues its roll, with the billowing dust cloud growing larger in its wake.
reconstructed_captions.34: The military plane moves further away, kicking up an even larger cloud of dust.
